description: This source file defines a Supabase authentication client using httpx for HTTP requests. It provides methods for signing up and signing in users via Supabase's auth endpoints, encapsulating the HTTP communication and error handling.

classes.name: SupabaseAuthClient
classes.description: A minimal Python client for Supabase authentication endpoints, utilizing async HTTP requests for sign-up and sign-in operations.

methods.name: __init__(self, supabase_url: str, supabase_key: str, site_url: str)

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] sign_in(self, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Calls the Supabase login endpoint asynchronously to authenticate a user with email and password.
